purpose: W7-B: replace process-local anti-fraud transitions and fabricated reputation fallbacks with a durable evidence graph, RiskCase and transparent versioned decision/reputation factors without turning scores into Deal or eligibility authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: W7-B uses a private risk_evidence schema and does not create a public score-as-authority model.
Risk evidence informs governed decisions but cannot mutate Deal state directly in the foundation.
Existing append-only Role Eligibility evidence is reused read-only; registration/eligibility remain out of scope.
The first authority can remain behind existing anti-fraud/reputation boundaries; global module wiring is not required for the foundation.

requiredInvariants: Risk evidence is append-only, source/provenance/version/freshness bound and fact-specific. A score is a derived projection, never primary evidence.
Process-local rapid-transition memory is removed from production decision authority; transition/rate evidence must be durable and horizontally consistent.
If persistence or required source evidence is unavailable, reputation/risk is UNAVAILABLE/UNDER_REVIEW rather than fabricated from hard-coded fallback metrics.

Money/quantity inputs use exact canonical source facts. Float Rub/ton values and hard-coded commodity thresholds cannot become authoritative commercial-risk facts without a versioned published policy/source.
RiskCase is a durable lifecycle for flag, review, evidence, response, decision, appeal/override and closure. Manual resolution is explicit, auditable and cannot silently edit historical evidence.
DecisionPolicy versions persist factor definitions, source requirements, weights/thresholds and reason-code mappings so every decision/reputation projection can be reproduced.

Opaque ML output cannot alone block, permit or rank a counterparty. ML features/model version/output are evidence inputs and every material action has explicit explainable rule/evidence factors plus human-review path where policy requires.
Reputation separates observed facts from interpretation and never publishes invented deal/payment/KYC/AML metrics. No persistence means no score, not sample data.

Current tenant/organization/actor authority is enforced for private evidence/cases. Public/counterparty reputation surfaces disclose only a separately approved minimized projection, never raw cross-tenant evidence.
Same-tenant outsider and cross-tenant access to private evidence/cases is denied; eligibility and provider evidence are referenced with exact source ids/revisions rather than copied mutable truth.
Every case/decision mutation commits immutable event, audit, outbox and receipt atomically with payload-bound idempotency and optimistic concurrency.
A risk decision cannot manufacture KYC/AML/regulatory/verification success, change Deal terms, release money or replace Role Eligibility authority.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, Progressive Trust, Provider Registry, packages/lockfiles and REG.RU-only production remain unchanged.
acceptance: Regression tests prove anti-fraud production behavior no longer depends on process-local transition Map state and persistence failure is not swallowed as a successful durable flag.
Reputation tests prove absence of Prisma/source data never returns fabricated sample metrics/score/recommendation and cross-tenant orgs remain indistinguishable from nonexistent where required.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove durable evidence graph, RiskCase lifecycle, versioned decisions, exact replay/conflict, tenant isolation and current-authority revocation checks.
A decision can be reproduced from persisted evidence ids/revisions and policy version with the same factor/reason output.
Missing/stale/conflicting mandatory evidence produces UNDER_REVIEW/UNAVAILABLE or explicit policy outcome, never an invented neutral/good score.
ML model unavailable or changed output does not erase deterministic evidence/reason factors or produce silent last-value fallback authority.
Audit/outbox/event failure rolls back all case/decision state and no acknowledged decision remains without evidence.
Exact-head CI/review, security tests and later REG.RU runtime acceptance are required before terminal risk/reputation credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Counterparty-facing minimized reputation UX, appeal workflow and ranking consumption remain later consumer acceptance.
External data providers/official sources for additional risk factors require separate IntegrationBinding/conformance/live receipts.
Market ranking must consume transparent factors without making score a hidden admission authority.
